defects.rationale: os.system interpolates the unsanitized filename argument into a shell command string, allowing attacker-controlled metacharacters (e.g. '; rm -rf /') to execute arbitrary commands. Lint security profile also flags line 4 as shell_execution requiring injection review.
The os.system return code is returned but never checked; a non-zero exit from convert is treated as a normal result, so conversion failures propagate silently as success to callers.
